summary: Implemented a deterministic offline quality gate for manually filled PMBOT dossier draft skeleton attempts. The gate reads only local manual draft, dossier skeleton, review-record result, and merged-packet artifacts; accepts only drafts for RESEARCH-012 skeleton market ids; rejects unsafe fields, immutable skeleton overrides, completed/final dossier language, non-skeleton ids, and structurally incomplete ready-for-human-review drafts; and creates no completed dossiers, market conclusions, scores, probabilities, EV calculations, recommendations, paper orders, runtime wiring, or live actions.

tests_run.command: python -c "import json, pathlib; paths=['pm_bot/research/manual_dossier_drafts_fixture.v1.json','pm_bot/research/manual_dossier_draft_validation_result.v1.json','pm_bot/research/expected_manual_dossier_draft_validation_result.v1.json','docs/PMBOT_RESEARCH_013_RESULT.json']; [json.load(open(pathlib.Path(p), encoding='utf-8')) for p in paths]; print('parsed', len(paths), 'json artifacts')"
